mapper.sql: target_type, target_id, official_score, user_score, display_score, review_count, updated_at
mapper.insert: insert into rating_summary () values (#{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{officialScore}, #{userScore}, #{displayScore}, #{reviewCount}, #{updatedAt}) on duplicate key update official_score = values(official_score), user_score = values(user_score), display_score = values(display_score), review_count = values(review_count), updated_at = current_timestamp
mapper.delete: delete from rating_summary where target_type = #{targetType} and target_id = #{targetId}
